BETA v1.10.0d (20 September 2019) |previous_update = [[BETA v1.9|Area 51 Update]] |next_update = [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''BETA v1.10''' was the eleventh update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 15th of August 2019. It was the last BETA update before Tower Defense Simulator officially transitioned from BETA to Release. As with most updates before the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], there was no official name for updates. As a result, the name '''BETA v1.10''' has been retroactively applied to this update. This version encompassed five updates, the main BETA v1.10.0 update (released 15 August 2019), and four minor updates, the BETA v1.10.0a (released the same day as the BETA v1.10.0, 15 August 2019), the BETA v1.10.0b (released 2 September 2019), the BETA v1.10.0c (released 3 September 2019) and the BETA v1.10.0d (released 20 September 2019). ==Additions== ===Enemies=== *[[Rusted]] *[[24 Karat]] *[[Deep Freeze (Pre-MEGA)|Deep Freeze]] *[[Frost Hero (Pre-MEGA)|Frost Hero]] *[[Lava]] **Added into the game's code but did not appear naturally, meaning it could only appear if it was spawned with admin commands. ===Maps=== *[[Dead Ahead]] (Survival) *[[Fungi Forest]] (Survival) *[[Subzero]] (Survival) *[[Four Seasons]] (Survival) ===Emotes=== *[[Parrot Party]] *[[Garry's Dance]] ===Miscellaneous=== *Final wave music ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Wave layout changed. **Hard mode now goes up to wave 60. **Insane mode now goes up to wave 68. *[[Soldier]] unlock cost increased from {{Coins|100}} to {{Coins|250}}. *[[Paintballer]] buffed. **Unlock cost decreased from {{Coins|750}} to {{Coins|150}}. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|1,000}} to {{Money|400}}. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|1,650}} to {{Money|700}}. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|3,500}} to {{Money|2,500}}. ***'''Level 5''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|7,500}} to {{Money|5,000}}. *Dataloss fixes. *Fixed being able to place towers on enemies during their death animation. *You can now earn rewards upon triumphing on [[Four Seasons]]. *Major bosses no longer get affected by [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' ability, this includes: **[[Molten Boss]]. **[[Gold Titan]]. :In a Shadow Update, '''BETA v1.10.0a''': *[[Frozen (Pre-MEGA)|Frozen]] now has [[Freeze Immunity|Basic Freeze Immunity]]. *[[Deep Freeze (Pre-MEGA)|Deep Freeze]] now has [[Freeze Immunity|Basic Freeze Immunity]]. *[[Frost Hero (Pre-MEGA)|Frost Hero]] now has [[Freeze Immunity]]. *[[Deep Freeze (Pre-MEGA)|Deep Freeze]] appearance changed. :Gamepass prices decreased as part of the Labor Day Sale 2019 in '''BETA v1.10.0b''': *[[Crook Boss]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|400}} to {{Robux|300}}. *[[Turret]] gamepass cost decreased from {{Robux|800}} to {{Robux|600}}. :Gamepass prices increased as the Labor Day Sale 2019 ended in '''BETA v1.10.0c''': *[[Crook Boss]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|300}} to {{Robux|400}}. *[[Turret]] gamepass cost increased from {{Robux|600}} to {{Robux|800}}. :In a Shadow Update, '''BETA v1.10.0d''': *[[Commando]] no longer obtainable from the [[Area 51 Event]], but the event continues. ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate as this is transcribed from the game's update log on the devforum.
